summary: Issue #253 follow-up slice (V9+V11+V12 MIDI event contract fixes). Scope: merge_call_events defined truncation, InputStage NoteLedger consolidation, anchor republish pending-event contract. Headless only; no real device/plugin claims.

V9 decision: over-budget merge degrades to defined truncation (stable prefix up to min(scratch, src_scratch)) instead of Err(MergeError::Overflow) empty delivery. Truncation amount exposed via MergeOutcome::truncated and NodeStatusSnapshot::event_merge_truncated; EventScratchOverflow report semantics retained. TooManySources remains the only Err path.

V11 decision: stage-side NoteLedger duplicated node authority and could diverge; chose honest Stage reduction (remove NoteLedger/release_all/active_notes/released/ledger_overflows) over keeping parallel state. Node ledger remains sole release/chase authority; stuck-note tests non-regressed.

V12 decision: publish_anchor preserves pending input (no drain/reorder); mapping evaluated at collect_block time against current anchor. Rejection classification added: anchor domain/base/epoch mismatch -> anchor_rejected; BeforeAnchor/Overflow -> rejected only; anchor None -> pending held, no counting.
Lint fix: run_call exceeded clippy too_many_lines (104/100) after merge handling change; extracted merge_window helper (merge + truncation counter + empty-delivery fallback). No #[allow] used.

Verification (mise run, Windows headless, rustc 1.99.1): fmt-check, check/lint/test for ruviform-plugin-core and ruviform-audio-plugin-bridge, test-plugin-core, lint-plugin-core, test-rt, test-l1-real-plugin all exit 0. Evidence: evidence/rf253/verification-2026-11-15.md
